column1: # Per-file bats runtime in whole seconds, used by .github/scripts/shard-tests.sh
# Measured on macOS (the slower of the two userlands, so the weights bound both)
# from a green main run: run 34037049929, head b2530572, 2026-09-06. Method: each
# `ok N <desc>` line's own GitHub Actions timestamp minus the previous one,
# attributed to the file whose `@test` block carries that description. 2179 of
# 2198 ok-lines attributed; 3568s of the 3697s the four shards actually spent.
# This table goes stale as the suite changes, and nothing here checks that it
# has. That is deliberate: the worst case of a stale weight is an unevenly
# filled shard, never a missing file -- coverage is asserted separately by
# tests/test_ci_sharding.bats and by tests.yml's manifest comparison. A file
# absent from this table gets the table's median rather than zero, so a newly
# added file is treated as ordinary instead of being free to pile onto one
# Regenerate by re-running the method above against a green run's macOS shard
# logs. Format: <basename>\t<seconds>, tab-separated, one file per line.
